source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Why should you deliberately choose a project or local folder before asking an agent to revise a skill?

options.text: It helps identify which materials belong to the work
options.feedback: Choosing the working area helps establish the task's relevant materials. The same model can be more useful when its tools and context fit the work.

options.text: It trains the model on every file in that location
options.feedback: Choosing a working area establishes relevant materials; it does not turn skill editing into model training.

options.text: It confirms the skill already meets the task criteria
options.feedback: A folder identifies materials, not their quality. You still need to compare the procedure and its output with the task criteria.

options.text: It proves the final file was saved in that location
options.feedback: Selecting a folder is preparation for the work. Completion still requires checking that the intended artifact actually exists in the correct place.
